manifest: JM Build Route Manifest v0.1 — Coding Body Activation Trace

created_for.body: JM Coding Body Activation Trace v0.1
created_for.body_type: per-run Coding-Estate activation telemetry / proof boundary
created_for.intended_destination: Canonical sovereign-agent runtime and Current-64 standards on main

authority.owner_instruction: Make every run prove exactly which coding bodies entered it, then use that observability as the base for later factory/bridge specialization.

foundation.recovered_gap: The runtime could route work and expose all 64 identities, but it did not emit a durable exact per-run record of which coding identities entered the current runtime spine and which stayed available-but-unselected.
foundation.reuse_rule: Instrument the existing sovereign runtime and Current-64 registry; do not create new coding identities or infer future factory roles.
foundation.focus_boundary: Only the current sovereign-agent runtime spine is instrumented in v0.1. Dynamic factory/bridge/body-specialization rules are explicitly deferred.

true_gaps.gap: Exact current-run coding-body participation was inferable from architecture but not emitted as machine-readable proof.

policy_integrity.criterion: Activation policy must resolve exactly 12 current IDs, leave exactly 52 unselected, and keep adjacent organs outside the Current-64 count.

node_python_activation_parity.criterion: Python and Node --activation-only output must be byte-identical for portable, Android and Codex surfaces.

full64_accounting.criterion: Every run must emit exactly 64 unique body states with ACTIVE_ROUTE + AVAILABLE_NOT_SELECTED = 64.

host_surface_carriage.criterion: Android and Codex sessions must carry the activation record with their exact surface profile and preserve supporting-organ separation.

direct_process_boundary.criterion: Record must explicitly state route selection is not separate process execution.

host_and_surfaces.keeper: SELECTED FOR THE ROUTE ≠ SPAWNED AS A SEPARATE PROCESS.

current_escalations: If Node/Python activation outputs differ, fix serialization/policy interpretation rather than weakening parity.
If a selected code_id no longer exists in Current-64, resolve current identity authority before continuing.
Do not add task-specific factory rules merely to make the activation trace look richer.
escalation.failure_route: FAIL LOCAL → TRACE POLICY/RUNTIME/SURFACE CARRIER → CORRECT RESPONSIBLE ORGAN → RETEST
escalation.manual_user_contact: Only if a future body role/bridge specialization requires an owner-only design decision.

next_route.step: Open PR → run exact activation + downstream runtime/adapter gates → correct attributable failures → merge on green → canonical readback.

manifest_proof.result: PASS — instruments the existing runtime with exact body participation without inventing future factory roles or upgrading selection into process-execution proof.
